answer: 最终同600股来源任务收束、下列既定核验通过后，可以执行一次冻结的财务因子比较，并交付适用范围明确的历史结论。不能预先保证有效、代表全600股、代表全市场或证明高质量；当前source-panel-02只是部分采集诊断。资料不全不是自动停工理由，也不能增加新样本门槛或要求旧泛化公告全部清零。

allowed_projection.purpose: 已有决策时可用性标签，仅用于准确还原冻结样本池；未读取价格结果、未来收益、停牌结果或旧方法权重

partial_stage_facts.catalog_coverage_note: 目录覆盖不等于代码采集终结；本阶段仍有running/pending。最终报告区分终结尝试、目录完整、PDF成功、字段合格和进入比较。

source_only_calculation_definitions.pool: base=existing eligibility_reason==eligible AND historical industry known and not J; GP=base AND gp qualified; cash-common=GP AND cfo qualified. No future status/outDate/return is used for membership.
source_only_calculation_definitions.selection_opportunity: For each month/pool count n_s per sector, N=sum n_s. Frozen n_s<5 holds all methods: tiny_mass=sum(n_s where n_s<5)/N. Selectable_mass=1-tiny_mass. Selected slots for F or M=sum(n_s if n_s<5 else ceil(.2*n_s)); report slots/N, not an asserted20% of the whole pool.
source_only_calculation_definitions.nonconstant_score: Sum sector stock counts where n_s>=5 and financial score has>1 distinct value, divided by N; this is ability to use that score, not demonstrated return information.
source_only_calculation_definitions.exit_attrition: Group fixed600 by saved retrospective outDate<=2025-12-31 vs no known such date, for description only. Count all rows, existing price/industry base, catalog-covered base, GP/common rows. Conditional common coverage=common rows/catalog-covered base rows. Never use this grouping to drop future-delisted stocks.
source_only_calculation_definitions.industry_attrition: For each known nonfinancial industry, common/base among rows passing existing price criteria and catalog coverage. This is informative missingness description, not inverse-probability correction or a new weighting scheme.
source_only_calculation_definitions.recovery_share: Among actual GP/common pool stock-months, fraction with applicable v2 unreviewed-prior measurement-recovery flag; preserve flag, never relabel old notices cleared.
source_only_calculation_definitions.reuse_at_final: These source-only summaries should be updated once using the final source snapshot, as a final-stage source check; no repeated financial-effect variants.

necessary_before_first_effect.check: Same600 collection stage reaches documented terminal outcomes for all intended codes/targets; success is not required. Record failed/unissued reasons and any true source/budget stop; retain all600x132 rows. No pending work that changes declared final dataset is silently called complete.

Bind final immutable progress/preparation/panel/source manifest, parser, rulesv2/amendment02, design/amendment01 and evaluation code hashes. Verify final unique keys/dates/code set and expected failed latest annual retention; use existing validators, do not repeat full historical PDF audit.
necessary_before_first_effect.current: panel02 hashes and shape checked; final binding pending

necessary_before_first_effect.check: Carry forward completed parser/source checks tied to exact current parser. New format/semantic change needs targeted affected checks; do not require every PDF reread. Current independent review covers6 newly qualified reports+6 regression reports,48 fields, with text-layer and parser-nominated-page limits retained.

limitations: Text-layer verification only; no rendered-page visual audit.
The pypdf check uses the current parser to nominate pages, then verifies the amounts against original PDF text and preceding table headers.

necessary_before_first_effect.check: Reconcile final pools using existing past-price eligibility, historical industry and independent financial qualification; direct GP-vs-CFO uses identical common pool with all baselines recomputed. Recompute source-only coverage by month/year/industry and known later exit tags, including reasons rather than silently replacing excluded codes.
necessary_before_first_effect.current: performed for partial snapshot; final update pending

necessary_before_first_effect.check: Confirm final same-day/publicdate<decision, latest-failed-no-fallback,16-month age, same-report fields and known current correction conflict boundaries. V2 recovery keeps unreviewed flags and requires both fiscalend/publication later than event; no prior-date backfill. Reuse current tests and audit affected final rows.
necessary_before_first_effect.current: qualified/recovery date inequalities passed on partial audit; other semantic tests reused, final affected audit pending

necessary_before_first_effect.check: Quantify tiny-sector hold-all mass and selected-slot fraction, plus months with any score selection opportunity. Keep frozen tiny-sector rule and all planned months; do not change sector granularity or remove low-opportunity months to seek an effect. No new numeric adequacy cutoff.
necessary_before_first_effect.current: performed; in partial common pool median57.92% of weight is forced hold-all

necessary_before_first_effect.check: Preserve existing future-return missing-weight and quote-versus-fill rules before effects. Do not require complete future outcomes for entry or delete exited stocks retrospectively. Existing evaluator and independent reconciliation contracts govern later verification; this reviewer does not inspect future outcomes.
necessary_before_first_effect.current: frozen requirement retained, no outcome inspection

necessary_before_first_effect.check: Predeclare inference language before seeing effects: all132 monthly positions retained; fewer than120 comparable months cannot claim completed ten-year test;120 alone not sufficient. Report fixed6/12-month uncertainty and both financial candidates; do not treat stock-month count as independent observations or turn a no-selection opportunity zero into proof of factor ineffectiveness.

claim_limits: 600名单是2014-12-31历史供应商快照中2595只的确定性哈希抽样，已独立复算吻合。它排除了后来新上市者，也不保证原供应商快照覆盖当时全部上市/退市股票。
名单保留48只已知于2025年底前退市的股票、当前状态还含51只非活跃股票，说明没有简单地只取今天存续者；这不等于已证明无历史名单缺漏。当前outDate/status仅用于事后覆盖说明。
2026年回取的目录和PDF日期能支持按公告日期重建，但不证明当年的数据库到达时刻、完整目录或每个PDF从未被替换。结论称基于现存原始公告记录重建，不称完整历史实时数据库。
逐年行业快照及updateDate是历史分类代理，首次公开/供应商到达尚未独立证实，不能声称完全排除行业资料的事后变化。
原价格资格已排除历史ST、缺当月实际报价、上市状态不符和历史报价不足等情形。结论针对这套既定可比较对象，不是所有股票或只加财务资料而毫无其他筛选。
财务可解析、现金流字段可得和公告处理可用性可能随行业、规模、经营困难和退出而变化。相同池保证方法之间同条件比较，不能消除进入池之前的样本选择。
小行业全部持有使很多权重根本不使用因子筛选；不能把固定规则造成的零差额推广为盈利能力没有信息，也不能为放大效果临时合并行业。
GP/A是合并收入减营业成本相对于期末资产的比值；CFO/A是经营现金净流量相对于期末资产。它们不是净利润、盈利真实性、完整质量或治理能力；经营现金还受营运资金和税费时点影响。
同行业内比较减轻粗行业差异，仍不能消除资本密集度、规模、估值、会计分类及周期等竞争解释。B-M等差额只代表冻结方法中的增量，不证明独立因果机制或普遍alpha。
月度报价变化和固定目标权重不等于实际成交账户；停牌、退市财富回收、费用和公司行为处理限制必须随效果结果报告。
未来收益早已在既有价格研究中观察，年度财务数字又跨多个月重复；本轮不是全新未知历史的独立确认。132个月比79200股月更接近共同市场时间维度，固定重抽方案仍不能消除样本选择。
完成全部600股资料尝试只证明范围收束；最终结果可为支持、无增量或证据不足。只需完成必要已授权检验，不要求所有历史泛化公告清零或机械凑样本。
no_scope_expansion: no new factor or quality composite
no new return experiment or parameter grid
final_stage_decision: source-panel-02不得冒充最终600；最终范围收束并通过现有核验即可运行冻结比较。覆盖/选择机会诊断决定结论边界，不自动成为增加研究或停止研究的新门槛。
